messages:
elaine: Quick experiment proposal for the pricing page next week — short timeline but high signal. Plan: 1) Compact FAQ (top 6 q’s only, conversational answers), 2) Tier-name variants for small teams (3 variants), 3) Lightweight estimator widget with optional lead capture. Goal: +0.5pp conversion and fewer support Qs. Launch target: Wed 09:00 PT.

mohit: +1. For tier names I want to A/B test 3 labels: Friendly/Starter/Scale (not final names — just variants). Also need CS on billing copy. Can we track per-variant engagement?

julia: I’ll draft the FAQ copy — focusing on clarity and one-line benefits. Will strip legal wording and add a short line that surfaces unit economics. Draft by Tue EOD.

samir: Dev note: minimal estimator needs a single endpoint and feature flag. I can implement /api/estimate-v1 returning simple JSON: `{"monthly":number,"estimated_tokens":number}`. Lead capture will POST to /api/inbound-lead. Rough dev ETA: 3 days if design is final.

elaine: @julia add a one-sentence rationale per FAQ item so we can use it in the product page tooltip. Also include fallback CTAs: "Try free" and "Talk to sales".

mohit: Metrics to monitor: CTA click-through, estimator starts, estimator submit -> trial start, support ticket volume for pricing. Baseline conv ~3.2% — target +0.5pp. Also track tier selection distribution.

product-bot: Preview deploy ready: https://deploy.preview/pricing-experiment-1749999001 — visual + interactive estimator mock available.

julia: Pasting draft copy (short):
- Who is each tier for? One line each.
- Billing Q: monthly vs annual bullets + example costs.
- Security & data handling: 1-line with link to privacy.
- Refunds & trials: 2 lines.
- Migration/upgrade: 1 line pointing to docs.

samir: I’ll wire the feature-flag and route logic. Routing ask: any estimator submission where seats >= 50 OR annual_commit = "enterprise" should create an inbound lead to sales-inbound, else to sdr-nurture. Confirm if seats threshold ok.

elaine: Confirmed — seats>=50 -> AE queue. If user checks "we have >50 seats" also surface contact email.

mohit: For analytics: add event keys `pricing_estimator:start`, `pricing_estimator:submit`, `pricing_variant:select`. Send full payload to Segment.

elaine: OK — dev/design/copy all aligned. Launch Wed 09:00 PT behind feature flag, 2-week run, then quick retro. Thanks team :rocket:
